commands.name: Test Redis connection
commands.description: Check whether the local Redis server responds.

commands.name: Connect to a Redis server
commands.description: Open an interactive Redis CLI connection. Use configured authentication rather than putting secrets in shell history.

commands.name: Show Redis server information
commands.description: Display Redis server and statistics information.

commands.name: Count keys in the selected Redis database
commands.description: Return the number of keys in the currently selected database.

commands.name: Iterate over Redis keys
commands.description: Fetch a page of keys without blocking the server like KEYS may do.

commands.name: Read a Redis string key
commands.description: Read the value of a string key.

commands.name: Set a Redis string key
commands.description: Write a string value to a Redis key.

commands.name: Monitor Redis commands
commands.description: Stream commands processed by Redis; use briefly because output can be large and may expose values.

commands.name: Delete all keys in the selected Redis database (destructive)
commands.description: Permanently remove every key in the currently selected Redis database.

commands.name: Delete all Redis keys in all databases (destructive)
commands.description: Permanently remove all keys in every Redis database on the connected server.
